name: Security Identification 47
definition: Security that is a sub-set of an investment fund, and is governed by the same investment fund policy, for example, dividend option or valuation currency.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of the security, typically by an ISIN.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the financial instrument in free format text.

ShortName.name: Short Name
ShortName.definition: Financial Instrument Short Name (FISN) expressed in conformance with the ISO 18774 standard.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, for example, front end or back end, an income policy, for example, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, for example, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, for example, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

UmbrellaName.name: Umbrella Name
UmbrellaName.definition: Name of the umbrella fund in which the financial instrument is contained.

NewUmbrella.name: New Umbrella
NewUmbrella.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is part of a new umbrella.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, for example, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

BaseCurrency.name: Base Currency
BaseCurrency.definition: Currency of the investment fund class.

CountryOfDomicile.name: Country Of Domicile
CountryOfDomicile.definition: Country where the fund has legal domicile.

RegisteredDistributionCountry.name: Registered Distribution Country
RegisteredDistributionCountry.definition: Country where the fund is registered for distribution.

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Classification of the financial instrument. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00060.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Issuer of the financial instrument. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00070.

IssuerProductGovernanceProcess.name: Issuer Product Governance Process
IssuerProductGovernanceProcess.definition: Governance procedure that must be followed. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00075.

ProductCategory.name: Product Category
ProductCategory.definition: Designation of the product category or nature, for example, Pacific Equity, Equity Fund, Money Market Fund. If the product is a structured security product, the European Structured Investment Products Association (EUSIPA) code should be used as defined in the scope of European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00095.

ProductCategoryGermany.name: Product Category Germany
ProductCategoryGermany.definition: Designation of the respective product category or nature for Germany.|If the financial instrument is distributed in the German market, then the German classification of financial instruments code should be used. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00090.

NotionalOrUnitBased.name: Notional Or Unit Based
NotionalOrUnitBased.definition: Specifies whether the financial instrument is unit based or notional (nominal). When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00085.

QuotationType.name: Quotation Type
QuotationType.definition: When the financial instrument is a structured security, specifies if the ex-ante and ex-post costs and charges are specified as an absolute figure, that is, a currency and amount, or as a percentage rate, related to the specific reference value. |When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template reference 00096.

LeveragedOrContingentLiability.name: Leveraged Or Contingent Liability
LeveragedOrContingentLiability.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is leveraged or has contingent liability. This enables reporting on the depreciation of leveraged financial instruments or contingent liability transactions in accordance with Art. 62 of the MiFID II's Delegated Regulation as defined in the scope of European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00100.

NoRetrocessionIndicator.name: No Retrocession Indicator
NoRetrocessionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the share class does not pay retrocession fees and commissions. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00110.

ExPostCostCalculationBasis.name: Ex Post Cost Calculation Basis
ExPostCostCalculationBasis.definition: Specifies the basis for ex-post calculations. When used in reference to MiFID, this is in the scope of the European MiFID Template (EMT) reference 00120.
